verdict.rationale: VPM advertises a "Real U.S. street address" on its plans and sells TruLease, a commercial office address backed by a lease agreement and an optional utility bill, aimed at compliance for financial accounts. It also includes a free registered agent and LLC-formation guidance. The vendor itself says the standard virtual mailbox address is not enough for opening bank accounts, so bank KYC depends on the higher TruLease or TruResidence tier. Missing for 10: bank KYC is not met by the base mailbox tier; vendor-form acceptance is not explicitly documented; no independent or hands-on confirmation that banks or states accept the address.
